'''Dero Jin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]].

Jin sought to rescue those he cared about from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He believed that Rebel pilots, although few in number, were strong in their tenacity.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dero Jin is one of the pre-generated characters from the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]].
